findings.evidence: MediaController in MainActivity.kt and video elements in ChatScreen-D4g5_Ezi.js are used strictly for local media playback and UI rendering. No off-device transmission of user video files occurs.
findings.recommendation: No action required. User video data remains local to the device.

findings.issue_summary: User-Initiated Collection: Disclosure exempt, but must be declared in Play Store form.
findings.evidence: User explicitly initiates audio recording by clicking the microphone button in chat-interface.ts / ChatViewModel.kt. The recorded PCM audio stream is transmitted off-device via WebSocket to the Gemini Live service provider endpoint (wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com) for real-time voice processing.
findings.recommendation: Declare AUDIO collection and transmission under the Data Safety section in Google Play Console. Prominent disclosure is exempt because collection is user-initiated.
